1.

This application under Section 529 Bnss has been filed with a prayer to direct the court
concerned to conclude the Case No.264 of 2022 arising out of case crime no. 221 of 2021, under
Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Chharra, District- Aligarh
pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate-I, Aligarh expeditiously within a stipulated
period.

entities.text: D.P. Act, Police Station- Chharra, District- Aligarh
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant before this Court is the aggrieved wife/ informant in the aforesaid matter, which pertains to the year 2022.

It is further submitted the matter is pending for cross-examination of P.W.1/ applicant but the opposite parties are not cooperating, hence it has been submitted that in the interest of justice a direction should be issued to the trial Court to expedite the proceedings of the aforesaid case.
4. I have considered the submissions and perused the entire record.

sentences.text: In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to complete the cross-examination of the applicant/ P.W.1 expeditiously and thereafter all endeavours shall be made by it for expeditious disposal of the case, if there is no legal impediment.
It is further directed that no unnecessary adjournment will be sought/granted.

6. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder of the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and execution authorities, advocates, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
7.
With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
